payload.title: Which hyp commit implements hyp prompt and the constraints block check?
payload.body: Rivals are commits, each a Hypothesis tied to the base plus its change with hyp subject. They are added when they exist, because a one-rival Experiment is refused. A line is decided by go tests on the candidate.

why: The build's one question; its candidates are commits, added when they exist.
